name: Speaker Source → Set Announcement Volume
description: This action sets the [announcement volume](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source/#announcement-volume). If an announcement is playing at the announcement volume, the new volume applies right away. The value is not saved; after a reboot the configured `announcement_volume` applies again. If `announcement_volume` is not configured, this action turns the announcement volume on, as long as both `announcement_pipeline` and `media_pipeline` are configured.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The speaker source media player to control. Required if more than one is configured.

config_entries.label: Volume
config_entries.description: The announcement volume. A lambda returns a value between `0.0` and `1.0`.
